headline: Beta Glass 9-Month Pre-Tax Profit Falls 6.4% to N37.64B
summary: Beta Glass recorded a 6.39% decline in pre-tax profit to N37.64 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, as finance costs surged 45% and foreign exchange losses offset operating profit.
why: Beta Glass is a key supplier of glass packaging to major multinational beverage, pharmaceutical, and consumer goods companies in West Africa.

impacts.name: Beta Glass Plc
impacts.why: Pre-tax profits contracted 6.4% due to higher debt-servicing costs and foreign currency revaluation losses.
